Stream fact deltas as the worktree changes

Usage: ryi-server watch [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --root <DIR>         Repository root (default: git root of the working directory)
      --pattern <GLOB>     Glob to watch; repeatable (default: every roster extension)
      --kinds <KINDS>      Fact kinds (cst,type,call,df,data)
      --receipts <PATH>    Receipt store path
      --once               Emit one snapshot and exit
      --poll-ms <POLL_MS>  Poll interval when the platform watcher is unavailable [default: 500]
      --fresh              Run without the resident daemon (server mode is already fresh)
  -h, --help               Print help
